# Senior Scheduler - Civil Infrastructure (Rail)

Turner & Townsend PLC

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7448442677325932212?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=330&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5490585055220829252&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

Company Description

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

**Turner & Townsend** is looking for a **Senior Scheduler** to join our US Infrastructure team. This individual will have strong leadership skills and proven track record of successfully manage scheduling on prior projects or programs.

**_On-site presence is required 4 days out of the work week. Requirements may change depending on our client's needs._**

**Responsibilities:**

- Work in an integrated planning, cost and risk environment within the project to optimize the use of available resources to complete work plan scopes within budget and time constraints.
- Ensure that the established planning and scheduling methodology is followed in developing the project schedule.
- Develop Project Milestone and Progress tracking baselines.
- Assess subcontractor compliance with established scheduling methodology.
- Contribute to the development of the Work Breakdown Structure to support project performance measurement.
- Perform analysis of schedule data; identify trends, issues, and areas requiring attention and communication to the Project Director and Team.
- Communicate and collaborate with both internal and external clients on the project schedule.
- Contribute to the coaching and mentoring of the planning team
- Lead schedule reporting, including schedule forecast updates and schedule contingency management for specific work packages.
- Lead schedule updates, analysis, and reports in a timely manner.
- Ensure compliance with contractor schedules with the integrated schedules/milestones.
- Analyze resource requirements and availability impacts on the schedule and recommend recovery options.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.
- Graduate degree in quantity surveying, cost management, construction management, or engineering is preferred.
- Minimum 7 years of relevant civil infrastructure (Aviation, Rail, Transportation, Bridges/Roads/Highways, Tunnels, Utilities) construction experience working in a scheduling role supporting major programs. **Rail experience is highly preferred**
- Experience working in complex, fast paced, multi-stakeholder environments which require proactive coordination to ensure project/program success.
- Practical exposure to network planning structures and techniques, experienced user of Primavera Project Planner 6.0 or above, and Microsoft Project.
- Ability to assist with wider business initiatives as needed, including responding to RFPs.
- Demonstrates excellent presentation, verbal, written, organizational, and communication skills.

Additional Information

**\*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs\***

_\*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable._

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

# Sr. Human Resources Coordinator

Rhevera Medical

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5801486720999305694?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5874655113254119021&crId=US_0US_0)

Overview
Join our innovative, mission-driven Human Resources team as a Sr. Human Resources Coordinator at Endologix! This is a hybrid/remote position requiring at least three days on-site in our Santa Rosa facility per week, Monday-Thursday.

Who We Are
Endologix LLC is a California-based global medical device company dedicated to improving patients’ lives through innovative therapies for the interventional treatment of vascular disease. Our therapeutic portfolio addresses clinically relevant unmet needs, spanning from abdominal aortic aneurysms to lower limb peripheral vascular disease. We are committed to delivering excellent clinical outcomes through precision in product design, advanced manufacturing, and comprehensive physician training—supported by industry-leading clinical evidence. At Endologix, we’re driven by purpose, innovation, and the opportunity to make a lasting impact in vascular health.

Patient Outcomes Drive Us: We improve lives with every advancement we deliver.

Integrity Defines Us: We do what’s right, stay transparent, prioritize quality, and own our actions.

Innovation Advances Us: We stay curious, adaptable, and push boundaries.

Boldness Propels Us: We take smart risks and are unafraid in our pursuit of excellence.

Collaboration Unites Us: We partner across teams and with physicians to drive exceptional results.

What sets us apart is not just our technology, but our culture. At Endologix, we foster a forward-thinking, mission-driven environment where every team member plays a vital role in advancing patient care. Our core values guide how we operate. As for our people? We empower them with the tools, trust, and continuous learning they need to grow. If you’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in healthcare, you’ll find purpose and belonging here.

About The Role
The Sr. Human Resources Coordinator provides operational and administrative support across all areas of Human Resources. This role serves as a key point of support for the HR team and employees, helping facilitate day-to-day HR operations, onboarding activities, employee programs, communications, records management, and special projects. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-service focused, and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining confidentiality.

Responsibilities

## WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Employee Support & HR Administration

Monitor and help manage the HR shared inbox, routing inquiries and requests to the appropriate HR team members.

Serve as an initial point of contact for employee and manager questions.

Open, sort, and distribute incoming mail and HR-related correspondence.

Assist with HR communications, employee announcements, and company-wide memos and update quarterly slides and work with IT.

Support site and company-wide events, as needed.

Maintain employee files and ensure documentation is organized, accurate, and compliant.

Support general HR administrative activities and special projects as assigned.

Onboarding & Employee Experience

Coordinate new hire onboarding activities and support new hire orientations.

Prepare onboarding materials and ensure completion of required documentation.

Enter new hire information in UKG for Temporary Employees.

Send monthly onboarding communications and reminders to new employees.

Register employees in company-sponsored programs such as Noom, WalkingSpree, and other employee initiatives.

Partner with hiring managers and HR team members to help deliver a positive employee experience.

Support offboarding activities, and temporary worker administration.

HR Compliance & Documentation

Create and maintain HR Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and process documentation using Scribe and other documentation tools.

Update and maintain organizational charts and reporting structures using Visio or similar software.

Support document rebranding, formatting, and template standardization efforts.

Assist with employee handbook updates and policy revisions.

Help maintain and organize HR forms, policies, guides and department resources.

Administratively support employee status changes.

Employee Engagement

Prepare, launch, and administer employee surveys.

Compile survey results and assist with reporting and analysis.

Assist with company events and employee experience programs as needed.

Records Management

Organize and digitize personnel files and other HR documentation and records.

Ensure paper records are properly scanned, indexed, and maintained electronically.

Maintain confidential HR files in accordance with company policies and legal requirements.

Support file management and document retention activities across the HR function.

Qualifications

## WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

Education

Associates degree or one+ years of equivalent experience in Human Resources.

Experience

Minimum of 2 years of Human Resources experience, preferably in California.

Experience supporting pre-employment and employee onboarding, HR administration, benefits, and compliance processes.

Experience maintaining employee files and HR records.

Experience working with HRIS systems.

Experience supporting handbook maintenance, job descriptions, and organizational charts preferred.

Strong working knowledge of California employment laws, wage and hour requirements, leave and accommodation basics, and HR best practices

**Skills/Competencies:**

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).

Experience with HRIS systems such as UKG, ADP, Workday, or similar.

Proficiency with Visio or equivalent organizational chart software.

Ability to create surveys and analyze basic survey results.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong customer service orientation.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise good judgment.

Strong organizational and project management skills.

Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem solving.

What We Offer
At Endologix, we know that great work starts with great people — and people do their best when they feel valued and supported. That’s why we offer competitive pay, solid benefits, career growth, a culture that genuinely cares, and the flexibility you need to thrive both at work and at home. But more than that, we offer purpose. You’ll be part of a team that’s making a real impact on patients’ lives. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job, you’re building a meaningful career with a team that’s invested in your success.

The Compensation Package Includes

Base salary of $70K/yr-$80K/yr

Discretionary bonus

Equity participation as approved by Board of Directors (4-year vesting schedule)

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans

Flexible Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) and/or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

Generous paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays, and flexible time off that is available for Exempt employees)

401(k) retirement plan with company match

Plus

Flexible work arrangements, such as hybrid or remote work for many of our positions

Employee wellness initiatives, mental health resources, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Employee recognition programs and awards

Commuter benefits or transportation stipends

Our Commitment To Equal Opportunity And Veteran Inclusion

**Position Title: Scheduler IV**

**O2EPCM, Inc.** is a prominent award-winning experienced firm providing Professional, Technical, Consulting and Management Services in the Planning, Design, Engineering and Construction Industry to Local, State, Federal Government Agencies, Utility Companies and Private Clients. We are dedicated to delivering innovative and sustainable solutions for a variety of projects.

**Salary Range: $151,000 - $158,000**

**Location:** Onsite (Los Angeles, CA)

**Type:** Full-Time

**Employee Benefits:**

- 100% paid base coverage (Health, Vision, & Dental insurance).
- 401(k)
- Paid Holidays
- Paid Sick
- Paid Vacation

**O2EPCM, Inc.**

**Position: Scheduler IV**

**Salary Range: $145,000 - $151,000**

**Location:** Onsite (Los Angeles, CA)

**Type:** Full-Time

**Position Description:**

• Coordinate the preparation of project schedules based on defined project execution

philosophies

• Perform contractor schedule reviews for contract conformance and quality assurance

• Evaluate contract change orders and amendments for impact on budget and schedule

• Perform time impact analysis of project schedule delays and potential claims

• Participate in change order negotiations

• Perform Critical Path and Earned Value analyses

• Identify schedule related problems which arise during project execution and recommend corrective

actions and creative solutions

• Conduct construction/project site visits for progress reporting

• Review contractor's weekly and monthly schedule progress, prepare narrative of findings, submit

and present to management for decision making

• Review and evaluate contractor recovery schedules

• Perform cost analysis in support of design and construction phases of capital projects.

• Analyze actual expenditures versus budget performance

• Prepare cost loaded schedule to support comprehensive cash flow projections

• Understand, interpret and apply contracts, policies and procedures within Build LACCD

guidelines.

• Communicate effectively orally and in writing

• Excellent oral and written communication

• Flexibility in schedule and transportation to work at multiple sites based on assigned schedule

and duties

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

**Minimum Required Qualifications:**

• 10 years of experience in project or program scheduling on large construction programs.

• Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration

or other related field. Additional qualifying experience in excess to the minimum stated above may

be substituted for the required education.

• Advanced proficiency in specified software including, but not limited to, Primavera Scheduling

Software, MS Office Applications including Project, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

• Knowledge of theories, principles and practices of cost engineering and scheduling.

• Experience with time impact analysis.

• Experience with construction claims and change orders.

• Flexibility in schedule and transportation to work at multiple sites based on assigned schedule

and duties.

**Please note, if you move forward in the submission process, you will be asked to provide the following below.**

1. **Most updated resume**
2. **Certifications or Licenses obtained**
3. **3-4 Professional References**
4. **Project List with values, dates, and company of any projects worked**

Addison Group

### Job Description

Job Description

**Role:** Senior Accounts Payable Specialist

**Location:** West Los Angeles, CA (hybrid, onsite Tuesdays and Wednesdays)

**Pay:** $30 - $36 / hour, depending on experience

**Benefits:** This role is eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401(k)

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a high-volume AP professional with strong attention to detail and experience processing invoices. You’re accurate and reliable, and you adapt well to process changes, including a transition from 3-way to 2-way matching in an entertainment finance environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Process high-volume vendor invoices in NetSuite, ensuring accuracy and timely entry
- Perform 2-way matching of invoices against purchase orders (POs) as part of the updated AP workflow
- Help clear the AP backlog during the merger and NetSuite implementation, including resolving outstanding issues and cleaning up existing records
- Manage vendor onboarding and maintain accurate vendor records
- Research payment statuses, investigate unapplied or missing payments, and identify the root cause of discrepancies
- Navigate NetSuite independently, troubleshoot issues, and proactively resolve AP-related challenges
- Review invoices for correct vendor details, proper coding (GL/account, department, project, production, etc.), and accuracy and completeness
- Flag discrepancies, missing information, or unusual charges
- Communicate with internal teams (production, finance) and vendors to resolve issues
- Maintain organized digital records and documentation
- Assist with AP aging, clean-up, and reporting
- Assist with month-end close activities as needed

**Must-Have Qualifications**

- 5-7 years of experience in Accounts Payable, high-volume financial data processing, or accounting data entry
- Experience using NetSuite (strongly preferred; similar ERP acceptable)
- Strong data entry speed and accuracy
- Working knowledge of invoice processing and basic GL coding
- Excel skills, from intermediate (sorting, filtering, basic formulas) to proficient (lookups, pivots); an Excel assessment may be required
- Ability to quickly learn and adapt to process changes (e.g., 3-way to 2-way match)

# Senior Bookkeeper

$65k - $75k

Applications International Corporation

[San Diego, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Diego%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7019471929645134815?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7416&pageType=7&jobAge=234&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-320768176674980565&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

**About Us**

\\n

We are a dynamic SaaS company building innovative software solutions that make a difference in the Environmental Health Risk and Safety industry. Our collaborative team is passionate about technology and committed to excellence. We are looking for a talented Information Technology Manager to join our team in San Diego, CA and help drive our technical vision forward.

\\n

\\n

**\*\*THIS IS AN ON-SITE POSITION IN SAN DIEGO, CA 92127.\*\***

\\n

_Important Note: This is a full-time, on-site with benefits role in San Diego,CA. We are only considering local candidates at this time. Relocation assistance is not available._

\\n

\\n - Competitive Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000 per year DOE
\\n

\\n

\\n

**The Opportunity**

\\n

The Senior Bookkeeper is responsible for managing the company's complete day-to-day financial operations, combining full-cycle bookkeeping with accounting specialist functions including 3rd party billing, financial reporting, and corporate compliance. This is a high-ownership, self-directed role within a small, collaborative SaaS team, working directly with management. The incoming employee will benefit from a paid transition overlap with the outgoing bookkeeper with a hands-on knowledge transfer covering all systems, processes, vendor relationships, and compliance responsibilities before assuming full independent ownership.

\\n

\\n

**Duties and Responsibilities**

\\n

Core Bookkeeping

\\n

\\n - Manage day-to-day bookkeeping functions, including accurate recording of financial transactions and maintenance of supporting documentation.
\\n - Maintain corporate books including cash receipts, purchase, sales, general, and cash disbursement journals.
\\n - Post bills to journal, process invoices, and balance journals on a regular schedule.
\\n - Operate QuickBooks to record, store, and analyze financial data.
\\n - Collect, enter, or download financial data from internal and external sources; review for accuracy prior to posting.
\\n - Organize and maintain work papers, financial documents, and supporting records; file and retrieve as needed.
\\n

\\n

Accounts Receivable & 3rd Party Billing

\\n

\\n - Administer accounts receivable processes, including 3rd party billing, invoice tracking, and follow-up on outstanding balances.
\\n - Submit and manage billing through client portals including Coupa, Ariba, and/or ESIC depending on client platform requirements.
\\n - Correspond directly with external billing contacts and clients to resolve billing inquiries, disputes, and outstanding balances.
\\n - Make collection calls and emails, post payments, and record corresponding journal entries.
\\n - Prepare and maintain AR aging reports; escalate delinquent accounts as needed.
\\n

\\n

Accounts Payable

\\n

\\n - Oversee accounts payable activities by reviewing invoices, preparing payments, and ensuring obligations are settled within expected timelines.
\\n - Process check runs and vendor payments; prepare signature-ready checks.
\\n - Maintain organized AP files, vendor records, and supporting documentation.
\\n

\\n

Bank & Account Reconciliations

\\n

\\n - Perform bank and account reconciliations — including credit cards, petty cash, and loans — to confirm financial records are complete, balanced, and up to date.
\\n - Prepare bank deposits; identify and escalate discrepancies promptly.
\\n - Administer general ledger coding, postings, and documentation to ensure correct entry and audit-ready records.
\\n

\\n

Payroll

\\n

\\n - Process company bi-weekly payroll using ADP Workforce Now with a high level of accuracy, including reviewing timesheets, deductions, and time off accruals.
\\n - Ensure payroll compliance and maintain accurate employee records.
\\n - Limited certified payroll reporting as needed.
\\n

\\n

Financial Reporting

\\n

\\n - Prepare and maintain various accounting reports for leadership review.
\\n - Prepare and present monthly financial statements to management.
\\n

\\n

Reporting & Compliance

\\n

\\n - Work with management and CPA on tax issues, document requests, and year-end closing process.
\\n - Provide organized, accurate financial records and documentation to facilitate CPA review and filing deadlines.
\\n - Maintain multi-state business licenses — manage yearly and quarterly renewal deadlines across all applicable jurisdictions.
\\n - Prepare and file Statement of Officer Information and Annual Reports as required by state.
\\n - Prepare and submit Property Tax Reports accurately and on time.
\\n - Monitor company contracts and send out requests for new insurance quotes.
\\n

\\n

Office & Vendor Coordination

\\n

\\n - Manage landlord lease relationship including correspondence, renewal tracking, and critical date management.
\\n - Coordinate essential office services such as shipping, mail distribution, supply ordering, equipment needs, and routine operational requests.
\\n - Maintain productive relationships with vendors, service providers, landlords, and internal teams to support uninterrupted office operations.
\\n - Partner with HR and IT contacts to help uphold office procedures, support policy administration, and address office equipment needs.
\\n - Maintain organized corporate filing system pertaining to financial, compliance, and administrative records.
\\n - Other duties as assigned.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**The Ideal Candidate**

\\n

Required

\\n

\\n - 5+ years of experience in full charge bookkeeping or accounting support with end-to-end financial responsibilities.
\\n - Proficiency in QuickBooks (QBO and/or Enterprise) with strong working knowledge of core bookkeeping practices.
\\n - Proficiency in 3rd party billing platforms such as Coupa, ESIC, Ariba, or similar platforms
\\n - Hands-on ADP Workforce Now payroll processing experience.
\\n - Proven ability to manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations with close attention to detail.
\\n - Experience making collections calls directly and managing aging accounts.
\\n - Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance financial duties, compliance responsibilities, and office coordination tasks.
\\n - Clear written and verbal communication skills for working with employees, vendors, and management.
\\n - Proficiency with standard office software; ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
\\n

\\n

Preferred

\\n

\\n - Experience with multi-state business license renewals and corporate annual report filings.
\\n - Experience supporting a CPA through year-end close and tax season.
\\n - QuickBooks implementation or system transition experience.
\\n - SaaS or subscription-revenue business background.
\\n - Knowledge of California payroll compliance requirements.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Education/Professional Experience**

\\n

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

\\n

\\n

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

\\n

\\n - Strong working knowledge of full-cycle accounting principles including AR, AP, GL, reconciliations, and payroll.
\\n - Demonstrated ability to manage 3rd party billing through external client portals (Coupa, Ariba, ESIC, or similar).
\\n - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in financial recordkeeping and reporting.
\\n - Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent accounting functions independently.
\\n - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to identify and resolve discrepancies proactively.
\\n - Professional written and verbal communication skills, including direct client and vendor correspondence.
\\n - Competency with QuickBooks (QBO and/or Enterprise) and ADP Workforce Now.
\\n - Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive financial and employee information.
\\n - Comfortable working directly with management and external CPA with minimal oversight.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Competitive Salary and Benefits Package**

\\n

\\n - Competitive Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000 per year DOE
\\n - 401K Retirement with a generous 6% employer match – 100% vested immediately
\\n - Medical Coverage (HMO & PPO options) – 100% paid by employer for employee and their dependents
\\n - Employer-paid life insurance
\\n - Dental and Vision coverage
\\n - Vacation Hours
\\n - Paid Holidays
\\n - Sick Leave
\\n - Wellness Program including weekly chair massage and in-office gym
\\n - Training and advancement opportunities
\\n - Company-provided daily office snacks
\\n - Dog-friendly office
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Work Schedule & Location**

\\n

\\n - Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM; occasional weekends depending on business needs
\\n - On-site position in San Diego, CA 92127
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Physical Requirements**

\\n

_The physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job with or without reasonable accommodation._

\\n

\\n - This position primarily involves computer work in an office environment and may occasionally require lifting/moving items up to 50 pounds.
\\n

\\n

\\n

# Senior Content Marketing Manager

Location:USCompany:Avante

## Description:

**About Avante**

Ask any employee to explain their benefits, and you'll likely get a confused shrug. Ask any HR leader if their benefits investment is working, and you'll get an honest "I don't know." For employees, benefits are confusing and overwhelming. For HR and finance leaders, benefits are the second-largest expense, but they lack the visibility to know what's working and what's wasted.

At Avante, we're changing that. We're an AI-native benefits intelligence platform built to help companies and HR leaders run benefits more effectively with AI. For employees, our agent Carly provides personalized, always-on benefits guidance. For benefits leaders, our agent Ava serves as the extension of the Benefits team, handling operational workload and giving them better insights, sooner.

We're based in Seattle and expanding our presence to New York City, and work 4 days a week in the office (one day remote). We sell to Fortune 2000 employers, with customers like Samsung, Zscaler, and News Corp, and our marketing team is still small enough that one person's writing sets the tone for how the entire market understands what we do. We're looking for a Senior Content Marketing Manager to be that person.

**The Role**

AI for benefits barely existed two years ago, and someone has to write the story of why it matters. That's this role: You'll be the voice behind the ideas, events, and content that make HR and benefits leaders sit up and pay attention.

Day to day, you'll plan and write across a range of formats: blog posts, sales enablement materials, event and webinar content, social, and more, moving fluidly between short-term production and longer-term editorial planning. You'll partner closely with product marketing, demand generation, and creative to make sure content ladders up to the right goals and reaches the right audience, and you'll use data to figure out what's working and adjust accordingly.

This is a senior individual contributor role built for a writer at heart: You'll launch thought leadership communications, shape the narrative behind our webinars and panels, and turn Avante's customer relationships into stories nobody else can tell. You'll own and curate Avante’s brand voice, and identify areas of improvement as this industry continues to develop. What's yours is the writing itself: the original thinking, sharp framing, and proprietary point of view that no AI tool or outside agency can produce.

**What You'll Do**

**Build Avante's content engine.** Stand up the fundamentals: a working content calendar, website content, and a steady cadence of GTM enablement materials that give sales something concrete to use in every deal.

**Curate Avante's point of view**. Build narratives, materials, and thought leadership that define our category, educate and entertain our buyers, and enlighten and engage our partners and customers.

**Write and shape our event content.** Build the speaker guides, narrative arcs, and talking points behind our webinars, panels, and podcasts. You provide the narrative and direction; creative partners handle production.

**Lead our social presence.** You'll shape what we say on our social platforms and make sure it sounds like a company with something to say, not another AI vendor posting for the algorithm.

**Support demand generation with nurture content.** Write the drip sequences that keep leads warm once they enter the funnel, and write to improve AEO and SEO through topical content, optimized for ranking.

**Protect a consistent brand voice.** Make sure everything Avante puts out, whatever the format or channel, sounds like it's coming from the same company. You're the one who catches it when copy drifts off-brand, and the one who keeps that voice sharp as more people touch content over time.

**Use AI to extend your reach, not replace your thinking.** Let it handle the mechanical work, slicing long-form pieces into emails, subject lines, and social copy, so you can spend your time on what it can't produce: original ideas, real customer stories, and a voice that's recognizably Avante's.

**Adapt as we grow.** Scope will shift as the marketing function scales, and you should welcome that.

**What We're Looking For**

- 7+ years in content marketing or a writing-heavy communications role, with a portfolio led by thought leadership and executive or event content, not general content ops
- Bachelors degree in Marketing, Communications, or equivalent experience
- Excellent, independently strong writing and editing skills; you can take a rough transcript or technical brief and turn it into something a senior HR or benefits leader wants to read
- Direct experience writing for events: speaker guides, panel and webinar narratives, or podcast content
- A track record of producing enablement materials that sales teams actually use, built on real relationships, not generic testimonials
- Comfort using AI tools to repurpose and extend long-form writing, paired with clear judgment about what only a human writer should produce
- Experience partnering with product marketing or brand partners and executing on their vision.
- Early-stage startup experience, including comfort being the only content person for a while

**Nice to Have**

- Experience marketing to enterprise-level/Fortune 2000 companies
- A published writing background (bylines, books, or a personal platform with real readership)
- Experience marketing to HR, benefits, or healthcare buyers

**How We Work**

Our four values aren't aspirational. They translate into concrete operating tenets that shape how we make decisions every day.

**Beat Yesterday.** We re-evaluate our own toolkit every quarter, because the workflows that made you effective three months ago may already be outdated. We act on 70% of the information rather than waiting for certainty. We timebox, execute, and iterate, getting work in front of real people quickly instead of polishing in isolation. And we own our output regardless of how we produced it. AI can get you 80% of the way there. Everything that goes out with your name on it is your responsibility to review, refine, and stand behind.

**Embrace Type 2 Fun.** We take on hard problems and find meaning in the work, even when it's uncomfortable. We assume good intent and follow up directly rather than venting in side channels. We celebrate wins loudly and specifically, naming the actual behavior so the whole team learns what great looks like. We are on by default, because we owe it to each other and to our customers to be available beyond what a regular corporate job would demand. And we do unscalable things today that build scalable advantages tomorrow: every hand-built case study and late-night byline turnaround earns us the right to scale later.

**Stay Hungry, Stay Curious.** We expect everyone to be the expert on AI in their function before anyone asks them to be. The landscape changes weekly. When you learn something, teach it. Learn enough about adjacent functions to ask good questions. Ask the question you think is too basic, because in complex domains like benefits, the cost of a wrong assumption can be a lost account. And remember: curiosity without urgency is a hobby. Learning has to translate into action on a timeline that matches the opportunity.

**Act Like an Owner.** We say the uncomfortable thing early, raising missed commitments or quality gaps directly with the person within 48 hours. We surface problems when they're small, not the week they become a crisis. Customer-facing work gets priority, always. And we close the loop every time, because over-communication is a feature at our stage, not a bug.

# Senior Payroll Specialist (Chandler)

Location:Sun Lakes, AZCompany:firstPRO 360

## Description:

firstPRO 360 is assisting our growing client in Chandler, Arizona seeking a Payroll Specialist. This position is onsite in Chandler, Arizona. The Payroll Specialist is a key member of the Human Resources, responsible for the accurate and timely processing of payroll for all employees and contractors. This role serves as the organization’s subject matter expert across ADP Workforce Now and will quickly become proficient in their proprietary ERP system - the platform used to capture all employee and contractor time worked and expense reimbursements.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on payroll processing experience, a strong grasp of multi-state compliance, familiarity with SOX controls and audit requirements, and the kind of platform fluency that makes learning new systems second nature.

**Job Duties**

- Process full-cycle payroll for salaried, hourly, and contract workers on a bi-weekly and/or semi-monthly basis.
- Operate across ADP (Workforce Now or Run), Paychex (Flex or Preview), and the company’s proprietary ERP system to manage time, expenses, and payroll data
- Review and reconcile employee and contractor time worked and expense reimbursements entered into the proprietary ERP system prior to each payroll cycle
- Audit payroll data for accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and ensure proper documentation of all corrections
- Maintain employee payroll records including new hires, terminations, pay changes, garnishments, benefits deductions, and direct deposit information

**SOX Compliance & Internal Controls**

- Support the organization’s SOX compliance program as it relates to payroll processes, ensuring all payroll activities adhere to established internal control requirements
- Maintain and execute SOX controls over payroll disbursements, segregation of duties, and access management across payroll platforms
- Prepare and retain documentation required for SOX audits, including control evidence, reconciliations, and approval workflows
- Partner with internal and external auditors during SOX reviews, providing requested documentation and responding to audit inquiries in a timely manner
- Identify and escalate control deficiencies or gaps in payroll-related processes to HR and Finance leadership

Senior Retention Marketing Specialist

\\n

\\n

\\n

\\n

We're partnering with a growing Shopify Platinum Partner looking to add a Senior Retention Marketing Specialist to its team. This person will work across a portfolio of high-growth DTC brands, owning email and SMS strategy while helping clients improve retention, engagement, and customer lifetime value.

\\n

\\n

\\n Own day-to-day retention marketing strategy across a portfolio of DTC/eCommerce clients\\n Develop, execute, and optimize email and SMS campaigns aligned with client objectives\\n Build lifecycle strategies designed to improve customer engagement, repeat purchase behavior, and long-term value\\n Analyze campaign and customer data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement\\n Establish measurement frameworks and report on performance, translating data into clear recommendations and next steps\\n Serve as a strategic partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities and guiding retention marketing decisions\\n Collaborate with designers, copywriters, analysts, and other specialists to bring campaigns and lifecycle programs to market\\n Stay current on emerging trends and best practices across email, SMS, retention, and DTC marketing\\n Contribute to the continued development of internal retention strategies, processes, and methodologies\\n\\n

\\n

\\n

\\n

\\n 3-7 years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, or a related discipline\\n Strong hands-on experience developing and managing **email and SMS marketing programs**\\n Previous experience working with DTC or eCommerce brands, specifically with **Shopify**\\n Expertise with **Klaviyo**\\n Ability to develop retention strategies and connect marketing activity to measurable business outcomes\\n Strong analytical skills with experience turning customer and campaign data into actionable insights\\n Excellent client-facing communication and presentation skills\\n Experience building and maintaining long-term client relationships\\n Strong understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, brand strategy, and content\\n Comfortable managing multiple priorities and client accounts simultaneously\\n\\n

\\n

Nice to Have

\\n

\\n Previous digital agency or consulting experience\\n Familiarity with **Figma** and creative collaboration workflows\\n\\n

\\n

\\n

### Job Description

Job Description

Company Description

**Turner & Townsend** is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

**Turner & Townsend** is looking for an **Scheduler Lead -Associate Director** to join our team. This individual will have strong leadership skills and proven track record of successfully manage scheduling on prior projects or programs. Qualified candidates will come from a background supporting large construction projects.

Responsibilities:

- Work in an integrated planning, cost and risk environment within the project to optimize the use of available resources to complete work plan scopes within budget and time constraints.
- Ensure that the established planning and scheduling methodology is followed in developing the project schedule.
- Develop Project Milestone and Progress tracking baselines.
- Assess subcontractor compliance with established scheduling methodology.
- Contribute to the development of the Work Breakdown Structure to support project performance measurement.
- Perform analysis of schedule data; identify trends, issues, and areas requiring attention and communication to the Project Director and Team.
- Communicate and collaborate with both internal and external clients on the project schedule.
- Contribute to the coaching and mentoring of the planning team
- Lead schedule reporting, including schedule forecast updates and schedule contingency management for specific work packages.
- Lead schedule updates, analysis, and reports in a timely manner.
- Ensure compliance with contractor schedules with the integrated schedules/milestones.
- Analyze resource requirements and availability impacts on the schedule and recommend recovery options.
- SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.
- Graduate degree in quantity surveying, cost management, construction management, or engineering is preferred.
- Minimum 8 years of relevant experience working in a scheduling role in the construction industry.
- Experience working in complex, fast paced, multi-stakeholder environments which require proactive coordination to ensure project/program success.
- Practical exposure to network planning structures and techniques, experienced user of Primavera Project Planner 6.0 or above, and Microsoft Project.
- Ability to assist with wider business initiatives as needed, including responding to RFPs.
- Demonstrates excellent presentation, verbal, written, organizational, and communication skills.

Additional Information

**The salary range for this full-time role is $140K-$1200K per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package.  Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications.**

# Medical Front Office Coordinator

California Foot & Ankle Centers

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6064752503278342261?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4590170970478135118&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Medical Front Office Coordinator

Location: Sacramento, CA (and other No Cal locations)

Schedule: Full-Time

Salary: Competitive Salary & Bonus Program

Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, EAP, 401(k), FSA, Costco, AAA, etc.

##### About Us

With a growing network of locations, California Foot & Ankle Centers (CALFAC) provides comprehensive podiatric care and surgery, including advanced wound care and amputation-prevention therapies, lower extremity peripheral nerve surgery, vascular medicine, and reconstructive surgery.

We have been serving patients in Northern California for over 60 years, building a loyal patient base keeping our clinic locations busy with little to no marketing during that time. Our highly-competent doctors and medical staff all believe in giving a caring approach to each patient, as well as our utilizing the most modern technology available. Further, we conduct clinical trials and podiatric research at all of our locations.

As a part of our team, you will be welcome in working with us for years to come as we do good work in our communities. We value team building, and our staff oftimes engages in after work activities in order to build relationships and play an essential role in our community.

##### Job Brief

A Medical Front Office Coordinator is responsible for answering phones, interacting with patients in a healthcare setting, and managing administrative tasks for the medical team. Their duties include scheduling patient appointments according to doctor availability, explaining intake forms to new patients, and checking in and checking out of patients, including processing patient payments. A pleasant, calm, and professional demeanor is essential, as the front office staff are the first and last people that the patients interact with. As a member of our team, we all provide a high level of efficient patient care, while always presenting a caring, ethical, and professional experience for the patients.

##### Essential Functions

- Answer phones and greet incoming patients and visitors.
- Perform patient registration and insurance verification, and collect co-pays.
- Prior to scheduling patients, check insurance and other sources ensure coverage.
- Request and obtain medical records for patients, prior to appointment date.
- Send medical records of existing patients, upon request and proper authorization.
- Scheduling of patients for available times for both the clinic, doctors, and clinical staff.
- Create and submit Requests for Prior Approval as needed
- Work fluidly in our EHR system (EPIC) to ensure info is accurate and complete
- Guide patients through the process by kindly talking them through the steps and answering their questions and concerns.
- Coordinate with office staff for timely care of patients.
- Occasional travel to our other nearby clinic locations to receive training and/or help with coverage.
- Participate in various projects and/or meetings, and complete other tasks as assigned by management.
- Cross-train and help coworkers as needed
- Perform general administrative tasks and assist with special projects, as needed

##### Qualifications/Requirements

- Knowledge and understanding of the workings of medical offices
- Strong experience working with EHR systems - especially our system, EPIC.
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
- Must have strong organizational and time management skills
- Ability to work on multiple tasks and meet deadlines
- Excellent communication skills
- Detail-oriented
- Understanding of medical terminology
- Be a team player
- MUST be able to communicate effectively in Spanish and English in-person and over the phone
- Ability to work on multiple projects and meet deadlines

##### Education and Experience

- High school diploma required; Associate college degree preferred
- 1+ years' experience with working in a medical office
- Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and other office software
- Experience working in EHR systems (EPIC strongly preferred)

##### Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, speak, hear, use hands, handle documents, bend and stoop as needed, and reach with hands and arms. The position requires use of keyboard and computer regularly. Strong vision abilities to perform extensive computer-related work. Ability to lift up to 15 lbs.

Two years of administrative support experience

Four years of administrative support experience

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

Ability to work effectively with others in person and in a group setting
Ability to prioritize, manage time, and meet competing deadlines
Ability to interpret verbal and/or written instructions at a proficient level
Ability to travel as required for corporate events

Robust benefit plans, including affordable medical plans
Employer 401(k) match
Paid time off
Tuition assistance

Job Description
Are you someone who thrives on keeping a busy office running smoothly juggling filing, invoices, supply orders, and deadlines without missing a beat? Are you a dependable, no-excuses professional who’s ready to pitch in wherever needed? Are you motivated by knowing your work, big or small, directly supports the smooth operation and success of the properties we serve? If so, we’d love for you to bring your administrative skills to the GoldSun Associates team.

GoldSun Associates is a management company that keeps our properties running smoothly for the owners, tenants, and vendors who depend on us every day. We are looking for a full-time Administrative Assistant who takes pride in the details, being dependable, organized, and ready to be the backbone of our office.

Job duties

Keep the office running behind the scenes by managing filing, e-filing, and records so nothing falls through the cracks

Own the ordering process end-to-end: researching and placing online or phone orders, following up to confirm delivery and handling any returns

Be the first line on incoming mail, sorting and routing it where it needs to go

Keep shared spaces, supply and storage rooms, clean, organized, and easy for the team to use

Get hands-on exposure to the property side of the business too, stepping in as Day Porter or parking attendant when needed

Qualifications

Polished, professional presence and strong written and verbal communication skills

Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to work smarter and faster

Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Excel; experience with Appfolio a plus

A researcher’s mindset comfortable gathering, organizing, and making sense of data

A natural multitasker who stays organized, on time, and solutions-focused

Skilled with e-filing and confident handling invoices, from categorizing to filing accurately

Typing speed of 40+ WPM, with solid scanning and printing skills

A minimum of 4 years office administrative experience

Experience handling personal data files with strict confidentiality, and a clear understanding of privacy and security best practices

American Society of Administrative Professionals

Description
Ethan Conrad Properties, Inc. is one of the largest and the fastest growing Commercial Real Estate Companies in Sacramento, CA. With over 12MM square feet, over 170 properties, and over 250 buildings, valued at $1.7 billion dollars. ECP has had an Annual Growth of over 20% for the past 10 years and anticipates continued growth of 20% annually, creating more job opportunities internally and externally. ECP is a World Class Company.

The executive assistant is responsible for providing personalized secretarial and administrative support to the CEO in a professional and timely manner. This role works one-to-one with the CEO on a wide variety of matters and is also part of the administrative team. The employee must be flexible to meet the demands of our growing organization. The ideal candidate will have a cheery disposition, impeccable organizational skills, advanced typing skills of 85+WPM, transcription experience and prior experience in an assistant role.

Requirements
**This position is responsible for:**

Accurate verbatim transcription and editing of digital recordings

Maintain focus and consistently deliver quality work within tight timeframes

Handle confidential information ensuring they remain secure

Be proficient in MS Office based systems

Willingness to perform additional duties as assigned by the supervisor

Full-time front desk coverage

Must adhere to all department protocols and procedures

Proofread and edit transcripts to ensure accuracy and completeness

Ability to answer multi-line, busy phone lines and transfer calls professionally

Assist CEO in personal tasks including booking travel, flights, and hotels

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Full knowledge of office management systems and procedures

Exemplary planning and time management skills

Ability to stay calm and on-task in high-stress situations

Ability to multitask and prioritize daily workload

High level verbal and written communications skills

Discretion with personal and confidential information

Minimum Requirements Include

Minimum typing speed 85 wpm, minimum 90% accuracy

Excellent attention to detail, active listening, and reading comprehension skills

Ability to interpret conversations and apply context to identify errorsAbility to manage and handle a high-volume workflow

Must be reliable, dependable, and have an excellent attendance history

Must be a team player

At Ethan Conrad Properties, we pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, which is pervasive throughout every step of a ECP employee's journey. Starting with our interviews and continuing through our executive open-door policy which includes regular, collaboration is at the heart of working at ECP.

We offer competitive pay, generous benefits, and a commitment to investing in our employees learning and development to ensure a rewarding and fulfilling career.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career could look like here at ECP.

NOTE: To apply, please send an email to with \\"Job Application - CX Manager\\" in the subject. Include a brief intro in the body of the email and attach your resume. Candidates will only be reviewed via email.

COMPANY: Hae CPG
POSITION: Customer Service Manager
REPORTS TO: CX Lead
ROLE TYPE: Full-Time
OFFICE LOCATION: Headquartered in Brooklyn, NY but the role is fully remote
HOURS: Must be comfortable with occasional weekend and holiday coverage

About the Company

Hae CPG is an operations, supply chain, and customer service partner for emerging and scaling beauty and wellness brands. We work as an extension of our clients’ internal teams, providing hands-on execution and management to keep their businesses running smoothly as they scale.

We support brands across the full product lifecycle, from early-stage setup through retail and omnichannel expansion. Our team manages the day-to-day workflows, partners, and processes behind the business, allowing brand leaders to stay focused on growth.

Our customer experience services include day-to-day ticket management, pre-launch CX setup, customer service strategy, workflow and process optimization, escalation management, and customer feedback reporting and insights.

Role Description

The Customer Experience Manager plays a hands-on role in managing and delivering high-quality customer experience across multiple Hae CPG client brands. This is an execution-focused management position for someone who is equally comfortable working directly in the ticket queue and building the strategy, systems, policies, and processes behind it.

You’ll oversee CX for assigned brands, from day-to-day ticket management and complex escalations to developing macros, SOPs, policies, workflows, and strategic recommendations. You’ll be expected to understand the broader CX technology ecosystem and advise clients on tools, processes, and best practices that improve both the customer experience and team efficiency.

This role requires strong CX judgment and a deep understanding of e-commerce customer experience. We’re looking for someone who can assess a brand’s existing CX operation, identify gaps and opportunities, recommend improvements, and then execute against those recommendations.

Responsibilities

Independently own day-to-day CX operations across assigned client brands, including direct ticket management and resolution
Develop and maintain CX policies, SOPs, macros, workflows, escalation paths, and internal documentation

# Payroll Specialist

Magellan Financial & Insurance Services, Inc.

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3550200549112768682?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3411036280065745719&crId=US_0US_0)

At Market HR Services in Wichita (markethrservices.com), you carry your own set of client payrolls — multiple employers, different pay calendars, different tax and deduction rules — from employee setup through direct deposit, garnishments, exceptions, and the follow-up that closes the loop.

Our clients outsource payroll and HR to us because they want a person who knows their account, not a 1-800 queue. On your accounts, that person is you.

**The work**

- Own assigned client payroll cycles on time: employee and salary records, checks and direct deposits, correct treatment of taxes, benefits, and deductions, and up-to-date documentation.
- Process and monitor garnishments; catch uncollected payroll, tax, or benefit-treatment errors, and data discrepancies before they reach a client.
- Answer clients directly by phone, email, and CRM. Explain the issue plainly, document the next step, and carry it to resolution.
- Escalate tax and policy questions above your authority with the facts and paperwork intact.
- As you absorb recurring volume, help shape how we deliver payroll for a growing client base — banks among them.

**How you start**

A two-to-three-month ramp in our systems and controls, working on live client companies, with review that tapers as you prove accuracy. Early success looks like routine payrolls done clean with decreasing review, problems raised before deadlines, and less chasing for the rest of the team.

**Pay and benefits**

Hourly pay on a wage grid that rises with experience and pays a premium for the Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) credential. 401(k) with company match; health, dental, and vision insurance; HSA or FSA; life insurance; paid time off; tuition reimbursement. Full-time, Monday–Friday, typically 40–45 hours a week.

**The trade**

The work is deadline-driven, repetitive in places, and unforgiving of loose documentation. The seat exists because the team is carrying significant volume, and we'll ask you to take meaningful ownership of your work; we're a growing operation, not a quiet payroll desk. Training and onboarding take place at the Wichita office. Limited work-from-home flexibility may follow once you've mastered the systems; it is earned, not promised. This is NOT a fully remote role.

**What we need to see**

- At least two years of hands-on payroll processing or administration; three to five preferred.
- Full-cycle ownership: setup, payments, records, tax and benefit treatment, garnishments, exceptions.
- Payroll for multiple clients, entities, EINs, or locations — shown in the work, not the title.
- Strong systems aptitude and spreadsheet skills; accurate entry and disciplined documentation under recurring deadlines.
- Client communication and issue ownership, with confidentiality and sound judgment in escalation.
- Able to work in the Wichita office through training; valid driver's license; Fundamental Payroll Certification at hire or within your first year.
- Ideal (not required): PEO, ASO, payroll bureau, accounting firm, or banking payroll background; iSolved, Paylocity, ADP, or a comparably complex payroll and tax system; the CPP.

If you've been the person who quietly makes payroll right and want clients, ownership, and a growing platform to match, apply and tell us about the payrolls you've personally run. See who we are and whom we .

# Accounts Receivable Specialist

$25 - $30 per hour

Century Group

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7158909687419436239?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5604605720244555105&crId=US_0US_0)

Century Group is partnering with a client that is seeking a Accounts Receivable Specialist to assist their team. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Expected starting pay rate of $25.00 to $30.00 per hour.

Job Responsibilities

Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and follow up on outstanding balances to support timely payments.

Record incoming payments accurately and research account issues to maintain accurate financial records.

Resolve billing concerns and payment discrepancies by coordinating with customers and internal teams.

Review customer account activity, maintain account records, and assist with credit related requests.

Support monthly accounting activities by preparing account reconciliations and improving collection processes.

Requirements

Demonstrate strong communication skills when interacting with customers and internal departments.

Maintain excellent organizational skills while handling multiple priorities and deadlines.

Apply sound judgment and problem solving abilities to resolve account issues efficiently.

Deliver professional customer service during sensitive payment discussions.

Utilize strong attention to detail when reviewing transactions and maintaining records.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in accounts receivable, collections, credit, or a related accounting function.

Understand account reconciliation practices and customer payment processes.

Use Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications proficiently.

Work with accounting systems effectively, with enterprise software experience considered a plus.

Manage a high volume workload while maintaining accuracy and meeting established deadlines.

Northern California Fertility Medical Center

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/9095392418737121758?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6000458205849547691&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Billing Specialist

Salary Range $25.00 - $30.00 Hourly Position Type Full-Time

Do you have a passion for helping people achieve their dreams of a growing family? An exciting opportunity awaits you with Northern California Fertility Medical Center (NCFMC), a leading fertility practice in the Northern California area! Our Sacramento location is seeking a full-time, on site, Billing Specialist.

**General Summary of Duties:** Responsible for the activities associated with the billing function. Responsible for using collection techniques to keep accounts receivable current including monitoring for delinquent payments. **Essential Functions:**

01. Gathers data on daily, monthly and yearly basis to determine status of clinic patient accounts.
02. Posts payments.
03. Monitors private pay patient accounts for delinquent payments and determines course of action.
04. Follows clinic collection policy and guidelines and refers to collection agency upon physician approval.
05. Uses collection management reports to keep accounts receivable current.
06. Uses telephone, mail, and other techniques to aid in collection accounts receivable.
07. Runs routine insurance claim forms and statements weekly per cycle.
08. Appeals underpaid, denied, or pended claims.
09. Requests, send refund checks to patients/insurance companies.
10. Answers inquiries and correspondence from patients and insurance companies; develops collection letters.
11. Identifies and resolves patient billing complaints. Researches credit balances.
12. Back up to front office, as needed.
13. Other duties as assigned.

**Experience:** Minimum three years of collection experience in a health care organization.

**Education:** High School diploma. Associate degree in healthcare or business administration preferred.

**Knowledge:**

1. Knowledge of medical billing/collection practices, ICD-9 and CPT coding.
2. Knowledge of computer programs, spreadsheets, and applications.
3. Knowledge of basic medical coding and third-party operating procedures and practices.
4. Knowledge of legal regulatory government provisions.

**Skills:**

1. Skill in using computer programs, spreadsheets, and applications for credit entry, retrieval, and modification.
2. Skill in establishing and maintaining effective internal and external working relationships.

**Abilities:**

1. Ability to understand and interpret credit policies and regulations.
2. Ability to respond to patients on credit matters in courteous fashion.
3. Ability to examine medical documents for accuracy and completeness.
4. Ability to enter data accurately and examine insurance documents.
5. Ability to communicate effectively and clearly.

**Environmental/Working Conditions:** Fast-paced conditions involving multiple tasks and personnel interface. Involves frequent in-person and telephone contact with patients. Work may be stressful at times. Interaction with others is constant and interruptive.

**Physical/Mental Demands:** Work may require manual dexterity for telephone, computer keyboard, and office machine operation, stooping and bending to files and supplies, sitting for extended periods of time.

The Role We are seeking a Medical Biller to join our growing team.This role is essential to the success of our practice, ensuring accurate billing, timely collections, and smooth communication with insurance providers and families.As a Medical Biller, you will:
Submit claims to insurance companies with accuracy and efficiency.
Review and process payments, adjustments, and patient balances.
Follow up on unpaid or denied claims, working to resolve discrepancies.
Verify client insurance benefits and maintain accurate records in our EMR system.
Communicate clearly with families about co-pays, deductibles, and account status.
Assist with administrative tasks such as insurance inquiries and occasional front office coverage.
Bill specialty service contracts including state funded services through billing portals and Quickbooks.
About Us At Metamorphosis Therapy Group, Inc., we believe therapy changes lives.Our mission is to provide accessible, affordable, and exceptional speech and occupational therapy services that empower children and families to thrive at home, at school, and in their communities.We're a therapist-owned practice with a strong team culture, built on collaboration, growth, and innovation.
Who You Are You’ll be a great fit if you are:? Detail-oriented -- accuracy and consistency come naturally to you.? Team-focused -- you enjoy working collaboratively and supporting others.? Adaptable -- you can shift between tasks, systems, and priorities with ease.? Growth-minded -- you're eager to learn, improve, and develop your skills.
Qualifications Familiarity with insurance claims, denials, and payment posting.Proficiency with EMR systems, Microsoft Office, and insurance portals.Strong communication skills and ability to maintain confidentiality (HIPAA compliance).Certification in billing/coding (CPB, CPC, CCA, CCS, etc.) is preferred
What We Offer Competitive pay:$22-$26/hr (based on experience).Additional pay consideration for those who hold billing or coding certifications.Full-time schedule, Monday-Friday.Paid holidays, sick leave, and PTO.Opportunities for training and career advancement.A supportive, therapist-owned workplace with a collaborative culture.If you're ready to bring your attention to detail and billing expertise to a mission-driven, child-centered practice, we'd love to hear from you! # OPERATIONS COORDINATOR

$23 - $27 per hour

Thunder Mountain Enterprises Inc

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-181393954711078935?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=330&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5487717264240736947&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Benefits:**

- 401(k)
- Health insurance
- Paid time off

**Operations & Administrative Coordinator**

**Location:** Sacramento, CA

**Schedule:** Part-Time or Full-Time Available

**Compensation:** $23-27/hour DOE

**About the Role**

Thunder Mountain Enterprises is a soil and water management company in the civil construction space. We are seeking an organized, resourceful, and detail-oriented Operations & Administrative Coordinator to support a growing environmental compliance and construction services company.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant position. Every day is different. One day you may be assisting with business registrations, permits, and compliance filings. The next you may be researching equipment purchases, coordinating with regulators, updating company records, assisting with bookkeeping, or helping management evaluate new business opportunities.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new systems, and helping keep a small business organized and moving forward.

**Responsibilities**

- Assist with accounts receivable and accounts payable data entry.
- Prepare invoices, maintain records, and support bookkeeping activities.
- Process approved vendor payments and maintain financial documentation.
- Coordinate business registrations, renewals, permits, licenses, and compliance filings.
- Assist with SAM.gov, DIR, Secretary of State, contractor licensing, insurance, and other regulatory requirements.
- Maintain equipment, vehicle, and business records.
- Research vendors, equipment, software, services, and business opportunities.
- Contact agencies, suppliers, contractors, and clients to obtain information and resolve issues.
- Assist with proposal preparation, document management, and project administration.
- Maintain company databases, filing systems, and operational tracking logs.
- Coordinate schedules, meetings, and administrative workflows.
- Support management with special projects, research assignments, and strategic initiatives.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, organization, and business operations.

**Qualifications**

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
- Ability to conduct independent research and solve problems.
- Experience with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and common business software.
- Experience with QuickBooks or bookkeeping software preferred.
- Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing needs.
- Valid California driver’s license and clean driving record required.
- Ability to pass a background check and provide professional references.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is naturally curious, highly organized, and comfortable learning new systems. They enjoy finding answers, coordinating details, and helping a small business operate more effectively. Fire Dispatcher Opportunities in Loma Mar
Fire Dispatchers help coordinate responses to fires, rescue incidents, hazardous conditions, and other emergencies handled by fire services. They receive incident information, alert appropriate resources, and maintain communication with responding crews.

This role requires organized information handling and clear radio communication. Dispatchers must keep incident details current while following established response plans and directions from authorized personnel.

Position Details

Duty Location: {airport\_name}, Loma Mar, CA

Employer: The hiring fire service or communications agency identified in the official vacancy

Pay: {salary\_min}–{salary\_max} per year

Schedule: {work\_schedule}

Appointment Type: {appointment\_type}

Who May Apply: {who\_may\_apply}

Application Deadline: {closing\_date}

Fire communications operations may require staffing at all hours. Work schedules can include overnight assignments, weekends, holidays, overtime, and additional coverage during major incidents.

What You May Do

Receive and document reports of fires, rescues, alarms, and hazardous conditions

Verify incident locations, access information, and reported risks

Alert stations and dispatch apparatus using approved response assignments

Monitor radio channels, unit availability, and incident status

Relay information about occupants, hazards, and changing conditions

Process requests for additional resources through established procedures

Coordinate mutual-aid communications when assigned

Record dispatch times, unit movements, and significant incident updates

Experience and Education Requirements
A high school diploma or recognized equivalency credential is commonly required. Some employers provide entry-level instruction; others seek experienced dispatchers with fire communications training.

Applicants should be comfortable with computer systems, accurate data entry, maps, and radio communication. Fire dispatch certification, emergency medical dispatch training, or incident-management coursework may be required for particular assignments.

General Conditions of Employment

Meet the hiring agency’s eligibility and minimum age requirements

Complete required background screening and employment assessments

Pass additional pre-employment evaluations when specifiedComplete required fire dispatch training and supervised instruction

Maintain certifications and continuing education required for the assignment

Remain available for assigned shifts and emergency staffing requirements

Work Environment and Physical Requirements
Fire Dispatchers usually work indoors at communications workstations with continuous headset, keyboard, and screen use. Major incidents may involve heavy radio traffic and prolonged concentration. The employer determines essential functions and applicable accommodation procedures.

Benefits
Eligible employees may have access to insurance coverage, retirement programs, paid leave, employee-support services, and professional development. Overtime, shift premiums, and other benefits depend on the hiring agency and position classification.

# Product Marketing Specialist

GIGABYTE USA

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5741791765896115405?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6470314192887182317&crId=US_0US_0)

GIGABYTE is a leading brand in the computer hardware industry, known for delivering innovative products that power gaming, content creation, and cutting-edge computing. Our marketing team thrives on creativity, collaboration, and bringing technology stories to life. We are looking for a Product Marketing Specialist to join our team and help streamline processes, optimize campaigns, and support the execution of marketing strategies across multiple channels.

As a Product Marketing Specialist , you will facilitate the planning and execution of product launches and marketing campaigns for GIGABYTE products in North America. You will collaborate closely with product marketing, product management (PM), e-commerce, and creative teams to develop and execute go-to-market strategies, build comprehensive launch timelines, and deliver high-quality marketing and SKU setup assets across key retail and e-commerce channels. This position will be responsible for ensuring product information accuracy, managing cross-functional workflows, and driving timely execution of campaigns from planning to launch. An ideal candidate should possess strong project management skills, high attention to detail, hands-on experience with e-commerce content creation, and a solid understanding of PC hardware to effectively support fast-paced product launches and commercialization efforts.

Primary Responsibilities

Support end-to-end go-to-market (GTM) planning and execution for PC gaming products.

Coordinate with Product Management (PM) teams to gather product updates, specifications, and launch timelines.

Develop and manage launch schedules, campaign plans, and cross-functional deliverables to ensure timely product releases.

Execute marketing campaigns such as product launches, bundle promotions, and seasonal initiatives in collaboration with internal teams.

Own and create e-commerce SKU setup assets, including product titles, bullet points, A+ content, and product imagery for key retail and e-commerce platforms.

Ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness of product information across all marketing and e-commerce channels.

Collaborate with creative teams to develop marketing assets, including visuals, videos, and product content aligned with campaign messaging.

Track project progress, follow up with stakeholders, and ensure deadlines and deliverables are met across multiple concurrent projects.

Support post-launch updates, optimizations, and maintenance of product listings and marketing materials.

Assist in analyzing campaign execution and e-commerce performance to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

Knowledge and Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related discipline.

Experience with e-commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon, Best Buy, Newegg) and product listing optimization.

Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple timelines simultaneously.

High attention to detail, especially in content accuracy and product information validation.

Ability to translate technical product specifications into clear, consumer-friendly messaging.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with content management or e-commerce tools is a plus.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

1–3 years of experience in product marketing, go-to-market (GTM), e-commerce, or a related field.

Hands-on experience supporting product launches or managing e-commerce content and SKU setup.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the PC hardware or consumer electronics industry (e.g., laptops, monitors, components).

Familiarity with technical specifications and product positioning within the computer hardware space.

Experience working with cross-functional teams including product management, creative, and sales.

About Us
Gigabyte is an international manufacturer and distributor of computer hardware products including motherboards, graphic cards, laptops, PC desktops, and more. We are actively looking for individuals to be a part of an organization committed to offering passionate fans with innovative technology.

We offer an exceptional benefits package as part of our total compensation plan, such as:

Medical Insurance (100% of employee monthly premium covered by company)

Vision Insurance

Life Insurance

401(k) Retirement Plan

Paid Holidays (including whole week of Christmas off)

Paid Vacation Days

Paid Time Off / Sick Days
